headline: TEN-DEEP climbs out of the well: THE RIM opens above
lede: Stage 2 of the Wizardry-style crawl (#1127) ships the surface world — the run now opens at a dusk hamlet on the lip of the well, where gold buys what the deep takes: hires at the tavern, resurrections at the temple, levels at the grounds, potions at the alchemist. A party wipe is no longer the end — it costs half the purse, and the temple can call the dead back at 200 gold a level. The Node proof stays pure: the shipped campaign still wins or dies on dungeon supplies alone.

notes.text: THE RIM: four facades + the well, painted at runtime — seeded stars, the Hollow Keep on the skyline, F descends, L walks back out.
Gold economy with a conservation law the harness re-grades: kills print xp/4 coins, buys book to the ledger, and a wipe taxes half each hero's purse — the cellar can't farm an infinite party.
tendeepcheck 716/716 (+39 town pins) with 6/6 mutants caught incl. a new free-hire giveaway; tendeepplay 37/37 driving the street, temple and tavern with real keys.
One CI trip: the 44-char attract fitter rejected two new title-screen lines — fixed the same hour; static green, merged 1668ab3.

look.text: Start at the RIM, hire a replacement, walk back down — TEN-DEEP (private)
